note: Locked coverage set of 31 individually-verified Options-Integrated (OI) and comparison tickers. Not organically grown — see AGENTS.md 'Coverage model'. Wrapper instruments preferred over individual monthly-dated rungs of the same strategy.

benchmark_anchors.note: Computed for every tracked ticker, always. Used for Lens C cross-fund comparison.
Used where a fund's own literature names the Nasdaq-100.

manual_fees.note: Before 22 December 2025 QQQ was a unit investment trust, whose prospectus states 'Annual Trust Ordinary Operating Expenses: 0.20% of the Trust's average net assets' in prose rather than a tagged fee table. The same figure appears in the 2025-01-27 prospectus. Tagged fee tables begin with the open-end fund's 485BPOS of 2025-12-19 (0.18%).

benchmark_anchors.note: Used where a fund's own literature names the Russell 2000 / small-cap segment.
iShares MSCI EAFE ETF. Used where a fund's own literature names MSCI EAFE. Added by 3F D-01, which closed benchmark_gap.

benchmark_gap.issue: These three funds explicitly name MSCI EAFE as their reference. No EAFE-tracking instrument was in benchmark_anchors, so they were computed against VOO only, which does not match their claimed exposure.
benchmark_gap.resolution: EFA (iShares MSCI EAFE ETF) added as a fourth anchor. All three now carry named_benchmark: "EFA". Retained rather than deleted so the reasoning stays legible.

tickers.benchmark_note: Fund's own factsheet states it is 'not managed in relation to any benchmark.' Bloomberg US Aggregate appears only as one of two illustrative comparison lines in fund materials, alongside an SG CTA index — not a declared reference. tickers.benchmark_note_plain: This fund states that it is not run in relation to any index at all. It is compared here against a US large-company index fund because that is what every fund on this site is compared against, and because the comparison shows how differently this one moves — not because the fund claims to follow it.
tickers.notes: Not options-based — included for diversification/comparison value, not as an OI fund. Uses futures across equities, bonds, commodities, currencies.
